purpose: Bind outcome-blind V1-native source artifacts from which protected parity cases may be selected. This audit is provenance and falsifier discovery only; it is not itself the protected held-out case manifest.
selection_rules: protected cases must be selected from or mechanically derived from frozen V1-native artifacts before any V2 outcome is observed
existing V1 test success is not a V2 parity success criterion; cases must be translated into capability-level inputs, expected invariants and honest terminals
a source file may seed multiple campaigns only when the mapped invariant is explicit; one observed V2 success may not compensate for another capability cell
hidden/held-out selection identity and evaluator custody must be frozen separately
V2-authored cases may be added only as hostile supplements and may never replace missing V1-native parity coverage
